thought.text:
Belum ada profil LLM tersimpan. Jadi ini masih kosong. Saya buatkan profilnya langsung lewat API, supaya `max_tokens` dan `force_string_serializer` benar dari awal.

Pertama saya cek API lokalnya.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && env | grep -iE "^(OH_|OPENHANDS|RUNTIME|AGENT_SERVER|PORT|SESSION)" | sed 's/=\(.\{0,60\}\).*/=\1/' | head -20; echo "=== port lokal ==="; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -12 || netstat -tln 2>/dev/null | head -12

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && env | grep -iE \"^(OH_|OPENHANDS|RUNTIME|AGENT_SERVER|PORT|SESSION)\" | sed 's/=\\(.\\{0,60\\}\\).*/=\\1/' | head -20; echo \"=== port lokal ===\"; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -12 || netstat -tln 2>/dev/null | head -12", "summary": "Discover local OpenHands API endpoint", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}
